trusted_assumptions: Lean 4.19.0, its kernel and standard axioms (actual dependencies printed below)
The pinned scalar GPU machine and its per-operation definitions
Python bounded PTX reader, fixed lowering and lossless token readback
Python PyTorch AST formalization of the independent reference module
Host launch geometry, contiguous float32 layouts, aligned and disjoint named buffers
Exact arithmetic interpretation: floating-point rounding and numerical error are outside the theorem
Race-free phase reduction from the sequential folds to GPU interleavings (external metatheory)
PTX parameter addresses designate the declared aligned disjoint buffers without 64-bit address wrap
scope: Bounded, concrete shapes and one-dimensional launches; all input scalar values
PTX 8.0/sm_80 scalar float32 subset; abstract exact add/sub/mul/max, not IEEE rounding
SSA integer/pointer/scalar registers; nonnegative int32 offsets without wrap; forward control only
Byte alignment guards are checked by the Lean machine before global float32 loads/stores
Full CTA bar.sync 0; one terminal ret; no shared memory, warp collectives, atomics or async operations
No NVIDIA compilation, execution, hardware conformance or timing evidence
Syntactic segment grouping and repetition; no general induction-based loop segmentation
Only computations with the same scalar expression structure currently prove automatically
